2O.8 Give thanks in public worship and addresses.

points: When David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel and gathered together all the princes of Israel with the priests and the Levites. The Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward, and their number man by man was thirty and eight thousand.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: Of these, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord, six thousand were officers and judges, four thousand were porters, and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments David made. The Levites were divided up for these different tasks.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: David divided the Levites into courses among the sons of Levi, namely Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, and named their families and their sons in order down the line. He names the father and then names the children, and then names that one's children, going down the line, which is like an inheritance each of them received.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: Concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi. Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name forever. Aaron was set apart specifically for that priestly part, along with all the other Levites who had their different jobs.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers, counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord from the age of twenty years and upward. David said the Lord God of Israel had given rest unto his people that they might dwell in Jerusalem forever, so the Levites would no more carry the tabernacle nor any vessels of it.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 23: The Numbering and Ordering of the Levites

points: Their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts and the chambers, in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the shewbread and the fine flour and the offerings. They were to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at evening, and to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord on the sabbaths, the new moons, and the set feasts, and to keep the charge of the tabernacle and the holy place. This shows the order and what each one's job was in the building and service of the temple.
